qe: The Directors' despatch of 1772, announcing the intention of the Company to stand forth as Diwan, ordered the removal of which officer who was in general charge of the nizamat administration at Patna?
qh: 1772 के डायरेक्टर्स के पत्र ने, जिसमें कंपनी के 'खुद दीवान बन खड़े होने' का इरादा जताया गया था, पटना में निजामत प्रशासन के सामान्य प्रभारी किस अफसर को हटाने का आदेश दिया?
e: 1770 me Patna Revenue Council banaya gaya, jiska president James Alexander the, lekin nizamat yaani sarkari prashasan ke prabhari Shitab Rai hi rahe tatha waqt ke saath council revenue ke muddon me dakhal dene lagi. 1772 me Company ke Directors ne apna prasiddh patra bheja, jisme unka iraada zaahir hua ki Company khud Diwan ban kar khadi hogi tatha revenue ka poora kaam apne haath me legi. Isi patra ke aadhaar par Shitab Rai ko uske pad se hatane ka aadesh hua, lekin local council tatha Warren Hastings ne unhe samman ke saath hataaya; unhe Calcutta bheja gaya, jahan jaanch ke baad unhone izzat ke saath wapsi pai tatha ant me unhe phir se niyukt kar diya gaya. Woh 1773 me Patna laut kar aaye tatha kuch hi samay baad unka nidhan ho gaya. Exam point: 1772 ke Directors ke patra me Company ka 'khud Diwan ban kar khade hone' ka iraada tha tatha Shitab Rai ko pad se hatane ka aadesh diya gaya; jaanch ke baad unhe phir niyukt kiya gaya; woh 1773 me Patna me hi chale gaye.

qe: After the death of Shitab Rai in 1773, his son was appointed Rai-raiyan of Bihar with an annual salary of fifty thousand rupees. Name him.
qh: 1773 में शिताब राय की मृत्यु के बाद उनके पुत्र को सालाना पचास हजार रुपये के वेतन पर बिहार का राय-रायान बनाया गया। उसका नाम क्या था?
e: Shitab Rai 1756 se Patna kshetra ke bahut prabhavshali adhikari rahe the; ve naib diwan ke roop me Bihar me sarkar ke mukhya pratinidhi the. 1772 me Directors ke patra ke baad unhe pad se hataya gaya tatha jaanch ke liye Calcutta bheja gaya, lekin jaanch me woh samman ke saath ubhre tatha ant me unhe phir niyukt kar diya gaya. 1773 me Patna lautne ke kuch samay baad hi unka nidhan ho gaya, jiske baad unke putra Kallian Singh ko Bihar ka Rai-raiyan banaya gaya tatha unhe saalana pachas hazaar rupaye ka vetan tay hua. Shitab Rai ke naibon ko bhi phir se niyukt kiya gaya, jinme Khiali Ram Agarwala bhi the tatha unke vanshaj Patna me aaj bhi hain. Exam point: Shitab Rai ke nidhan (1773) ke baad unke putra Kallian Singh Bihar ke Rai-raiyan bane tatha unka saalana vetan pachas hazaar rupaye tha; Shitab Rai ke naibon me Khiali Ram Agarwala bhi the.

qe: When the Patna Revenue Council was abolished in 1781, the Rai-raiyan took the farm of the whole province of Bihar and divided it with which naib?
qh: जब 1781 में पटना रेवेन्यू काउंसिल समाप्त की गई, तब राय-रायान ने पूरे बिहार प्रांत का ठेका लेकर उसे किस नायब के साथ बाँटा?
e: Patna Revenue Council ka kaam santoshjanak na hone ke kaaran 1781 me council samapt kar di gayi tatha poore Bihar prant ka ijara (farm) Rai-raiyan ne le liya, jise usne apne naib Khiali Ram Agarwala ke saath baant liya. Khiali Ram ko jo pargane mile, unme Bihar ke sabse ujad tatha kam base ilake bhi the, isliye 1781 ke patjhad ke vidroh se unke liye lagan jama karana bahut mushkil ho gaya. Saal ke ant tak woh bakaya ke kaaran kaid me daal diye gaye tatha unse unki niji sampatti se rakam nikalne ki koshish ki gayi. Kallian Singh bhi un parganon me safal nahi hue, unki doosri kist se hi bakaya shuru ho gaya; ant me 1783 me yah prayog chhod diya gaya tatha John Shore Patna aaye. Exam point: 1781 me Patna Revenue Council samapt hui tatha poore Bihar prant ka ijara Rai-raiyan (Kallian Singh) ne le kar apne naib Khiali Ram ke saath baanta; Khiali Ram ke parganon me sabse ujad ilake the, isliye bakaya ho gaya tatha 1783 me yah prayog samapt ho gaya.

qe: The complaint of the raiyats on 5 November 1770 led the Revenue Council of Patna to fix the maximum rent at what fraction of the produce?
qh: 5 नवंबर 1770 को रैयतों की शिकायत के बाद पटना रेवेन्यू काउंसिल ने अधिकतम लगान उपज के किस भाग पर तय किया?
e: 1770 me Patna me Revenue Council banai gayi thi tatha usne revenue ke muddon me sakriyata se dakhal dena shuru kiya. 5 November 1770 ko raiyaton yaani kisanon ki ek badi sankhya ne renters yaani ijaredaron ke zulm tatha zyada vasooli ki shikayat ki. Is par council ne faisla kiya ki lagan utpadan ke nau-solah hisson (9/16) se zyada nahi li jayegi tatha ijaredaron se likh kar wada liya gaya ki woh is se zyada vasooli nahi karenge. Isi niyam ko dakshin Bihar ki purani manyata ka aadhaar maana jaata hai ki lagan utpadan ka nau-solah hissa rehti hai; yeh bhi mana jaata hai ki 1781 ke kabuliyaton me vasooli ki rok ke niyam ke chhoot jane se bakaya badha. Exam point: 5 November 1770 ko raiyaton ki shikayat par Patna Revenue Council ne lagan ki uchchatam seema utpadan ke nau-solah hisson (9/16) par tay ki; ijaredaron se likh kar wada liya gaya; yah niyam dakshin Bihar ki purani lagan-manyata ka aadhaar bana.

qe: Who was the President of the Revenue Council appointed at Patna in 1770?
qh: 1770 में पटना में नियुक्त रेवेन्यू काउंसिल का अध्यक्ष कौन था?
e: 1770 me prashasan ki vyavastha badal kar Patna me ek Revenue Council banai gayi, jiska president James Alexander ko banaya gaya tatha Robert Palk tatha George Vansittart uske members the. Is council ko revenue ke muddon me naib diwan par adhikar diya gaya, jabki nizamat yaani sarkari prashasan ka samanya prabhar Shitab Rai ke paas hi raha. Council ne saal ke ant me raiyaton ki shikayaton par sunwai ki tatha lagan ki uchchatam seema tay ki. Aage ke varshon me council ke kai badle huye presidents rahe, jinme Richard Barwell, John Graham, George Vansittart, George Hurst, Thomas Lane, Robert Palk, Isaac Sage, Ewan Law tatha William Maxwell ke naam aate hain; 1781 me council ko hi samapt kar diya gaya. Exam point: 1770 me Patna Revenue Council ke president James Alexander the tatha Robert Palk tatha George Vansittart member the; council ko revenue ke muddon me adhikar mila tatha Shitab Rai nizamat ke prabhari rahe; 1781 me council samapt kar di gayi.

qe: In 1788, which officer broke up the estate of Iqbal Ali Khan and made a permanent settlement village by village with maliks and small farmers?
qh: 1788 में किस अफसर ने इकबाल अली खान की जागीर तोड़कर मालिकों तथा छोटे काश्तकारों के साथ गाँव-गाँव स्थायी बंदोबस्त कर दिया?
e: 1781 ke vidroh ke baad Iqbal Ali Khan Kharakdiha hokar Delhi chala gaya tatha uski Rajgir tatha Amarthu wali jagirein doosre adhikari ko de di gayin. 1784 ke ant me jab use Patna lautne ki anumati mili, tab tak uski bachi hui jagir John Shore ke settlement ke tahet ijaredaron ke paas thi. Yeh ijare 1788 tak chalte rahe; us saal ijaredaron ke bakaya ke kaaran Thomas Law ne us jagir ko poora tod kar gaon-gaon me malikon tatha chhote kisanon ke saath permanent settlement kar diya, jisme har gaon ka alag bandobast hua. Iqbal Ali Khan ka 1800 me nidhan hua tatha unke koi vaidh vanshaj nahi rahe. Exam point: 1788 me Thomas Law ne Iqbal Ali Khan ki jagir ko tod kar gaon-gaon me malikon tatha chhote kisanon ke saath permanent settlement kiya; Iqbal Ali Khan ka nidhan 1800 me hua; uski Rajgir-Amarthu wali jagirein pehle doosre adhikari ko mili thi.

qe: The estates of Iqbal Ali Khan in Rajgir and Amarthu were granted after his revolt to Ali Ibrahim Khan, who had tried to prevent which event of 1763?
qh: इकबाल अली खान की राजगीर तथा अमरथू वाली जागीरें उसके विद्रोह के बाद अली इब्राहिम खान को दी गईं, जिन्होंने 1763 की किस घटना को रोकने की कोशिश की थी?
oe: The mutiny of officers at Bankipore
e: 1781 ke vidroh me Iqbal Ali Khan paanch hazaar anuyayiyon ke saath lootpat karta hua Captain Powell dwara Guma darre me hara diya gaya tatha woh Kharakdiha hokar Delhi chala gaya. Patna kshetra me uski Rajgir tatha Amarthu wali jagirein us daur ke ek prabhavshali adhikari Ali Ibrahim Khan ko de di gayin. Ali Ibrahim Khan ka naam isliye bhi yaad rakha jaata hai ki unhone 1763 me Patna me angreji kaidiyon ko bachane ki koshish ki thi, tatha ve Warren Hastings ke saath Benaras ki yatra me bhi gaye the. Unke bhai ke vanshaj aaj bhi Nawab of Husainabad ke naam se jaane jaate hain tatha wahi sampatti rakhte hain. Exam point: 1781 ke vidroh ke baad Iqbal Ali Khan ki Rajgir tatha Amarthu wali jagirein Ali Ibrahim Khan ko milin, jinhone 1763 me Patna narsankhar rokne ki koshish ki thi; unke bhai ke vanshaj Nawab of Husainabad ke naam se jaane jaate hain.

qe: Rennell's map of south Bihar specially showed which two zamindaris, as if they were semi-independent states?
qh: दक्षिण बिहार के रेनल के नक्शे में किन दो जमींदारियों को विशेष रूप से दिखाया गया था, मानो वे अर्ध-स्वतंत्र राज्य हों?
e: Angreji kaal ke shuru me dakshin Bihar ki kuch zamindariyan itni prabhavshali thi ki unhe lagbhag chhote rajya jaisa darja prapt tha. Rennell ke dakshin Bihar ke nakshe me Narhat-Samai tatha Siris-Kutumba ki zamindariyan vishesh roop se dikhayi gayi thin, mano woh ardh-svatantra rajya hon. Aage ke saalon me dono hi zamindariyan vidroh ka srot banin: Narhat-Samai ke Kamgar Khan tatha unke parivar ke log Nawab ki sarkar ke viruddh khade rahe, tatha Siris-Kutumba ke Narain Singh ne 1781 me Chait Singh ka saath diya. Isliye Rennell ke nakshe ka yah vishleshan aage ki ghatnaon se sahi sabit hua. Exam point: Rennell ke dakshin Bihar ke nakshe me Narhat-Samai tatha Siris-Kutumba ki zamindariyan vishesh roop se dikhayi gayi thin, mano woh ardh-svatantra rajya hon; Kamgar Khan Narhat-Samai se tatha Narain Singh Siris-Kutumba se jude the; dono ne aage vidroh me hissa liya.

qe: Who came to Patna in 1783 and made a re-settlement of revenue for a term of three years after the experiment of farming out the province failed?
qh: प्रांत को ठेके पर देने का प्रयोग विफल होने पर 1783 में पटना आकर तीन वर्ष की अवधि के लिए राजस्व का पुनर्निर्धारण किसने किया?
e: 1781 me Patna Revenue Council samapt hone ke baad poore Bihar prant ka ijara Rai-raiyan tatha unke naib Khiali Ram ne liya, lekin 1781 ke patjhad ke vidroh tatha bakaya ke kaaran yah prayog safal nahi hua; Khiali Ram bakaya ke kaaran kaid me daal diye gaye tatha Kallian Singh ki doosri kist se hi bakaya shuru ho gaya. Ant me 1783 me yah prayog chhod diya gaya tatha John Shore Patna aaye, jinhone revenue ka naya settlement teen saal ke liye kiya. Ye settlement kisi sahi assets yaani aamdani ke aakdon par aadhaarit nahi tha, isliye ise saal-dar-saal badhaya jaata raha tatha aage Decennial Settlement tak chala. Isi daur me Patna se Calcutta jaate samay Shore ne bade bhandaron ki yojna bhi rakhi thi. Exam point: 1783 me John Shore Patna aaye tatha unhone teen saal ke liye revenue ka naya settlement kiya; yah farming experiment ki asafalta ke baad hua; yeh settlement sahi assets ke aakdon par aadhaarit na hone se saal-dar-saal badhta raha.
